# Bingxin and 繁星

<!-- Planned layout: overlay-center, sticky is a photo, period image or timeline -->

- 1900, Fuzhou
- May Fourth era and writing in the vernacular (白话)
- Fragments jotted down 1919–21, inspired by Tagore's *Stray Birds*
- Published 1923; the short-poem (小诗) craze it started
- Her "philosophy of love" (爱的哲学): mother, child, sea, stars

- Line 3: 何曾; 听得见 (whether it *can* be heard); 对语 (speaking with each other)
- Line 4: overview
- Line 5: overview
- Line 6: 深深的 (doubled, used as an adverb); 互相 (mutual); 了 completed action

<!-- Outside the line block, so highlight line numbers still count from the poem -->
冰心《繁星[·]{.interpunct}一》

| 繁星闪烁着——
| 　深蓝的太空，
| 　何曾听得见它们对语？
| 沉默中，
| 　微光里，
| 　　它们深深的互相颂赞了。
:::

| <ruby>繁星<rt>Many stars</rt></ruby><ruby>闪烁<rt>glitter</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt>[ongoing]</rt></ruby>——

| 　<ruby>何曾<rt>did ever</rt></ruby><ruby>听得见<rt>to be able to hear</rt></ruby><ruby>它们<rt>their</rt></ruby><ruby>对语<rt>dialogue(s)</rt></ruby>？
| <ruby>沉默<rt>to be silent</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt>in</rt></ruby>，
| 　<ruby>微光<rt>faint light</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt>inside</rt></ruby>，
| 　　<ruby>它们<rt>they</rt></ruby><ruby>深深<rt>deep</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt>[ ]</rt></ruby><ruby>互相<rt>mutually</rt></ruby><ruby>颂赞<rt>to praise</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt>[complete]</rt></ruby>。

:::{#cr-poem-dav  lang="en"}
<!-- Outside the line block, so highlight line numbers still count from the poem -->
Vast Stars (1) by Bingxin

| Vast stars twinkle continuously—
| 　Deep blue space,
| 　Were their words ever heard?
| Within silence,
| 　In the glimmer,
| 　　They have deeply, mutually chanted praises.
:::

:::{#cr-poem-cay-boy  lang="en"}
<!-- Outside the line block, so highlight line numbers still count from the poem -->
A Maze of Stars (1) by Bingxin

| A maze of stars glistens
| in the deep azure vault of sky.
| When before have I overheard their whispers?
| In the profound silence,
| in their own faint light,
| this deep acknowledgment of one another.
:::

:::{#cr-poem-lin  lang="en"}
<!-- Outside the line block, so highlight line numbers still count from the poem -->
Infinite Stars (1) by Bingxin

| Infinite stars sparkle
| 　In the deep blues of sky
| 　Does anyone ever hear them talk?
| In the depths of silence
| 　Within this faint light
| 　　They brightly sing one another's praise.
:::
